title: Input Matrix Optimization for Desired Reachable Set Warping of Linear Systems
summary: Shaping the reachable set of a dynamical system is a fundamental challenge in control design, with direct implications for both performance and safety. This paper considers the problem of selecting the optimal input matrix for a linear system that maximizes warping of the reachable set along a direction of interest. The main result establishes that under certain assumptions on the dynamics, the problem reduces to a finite number of linear optimization problems.
